title: Retrenchment
summary: RETRENCH'MENT, noun 1. The act of lopping off; the act of removing what is superfluous; as the retrenchment of words or lines in a writing. 2. The act of curtailing, lessening or abridging; diminution

inlines.v: RETRENCH'MENT, noun 1. The act of lopping off; the act of removing what is superfluous; as the retrenchment of words or lines in a writing. 2. The act of curtailing, lessening or abridging; diminution; as the retrenchment of expenses. 3. In military affairs, any work raised to cover a post and fortify it against an enemy; such as fascines, gabions, sandbags and the like.
